description: GeoCallao is the open geographic data hub of the Regional Government of Callao, the port province next to Lima. The hub search service read on 2026-09-28 lists 43 datasets, most updated in 2025 and 2026: tsunami inundation areas, evacuation routes and assembly points for Callao, Ventanilla, Bellavista, La Perla and Mi Perú, shelters by district, early warning siren locations, geology, geomorphology, a geological hazard inventory and a combined geotechnical layer, slopes and bathymetric contours, housing typology and housing precariousness, urban land use, the railway network, water hydrants, health centres and administrative limits. Coverage is the Callao region. Access is free download from the hub; some layers state free use with attribution of the source, while others carry no licence text. Caveats: several layers are district-level working files with terse names and uneven metadata. It supports tsunami and earthquake exposure and evacuation studies, such as testing shelter capacity and route lengths for the port and airport districts. Related record: the RIESGOS Lima and Callao residential exposure and loss models cover the same area.
